run_serve_subcommand: run the vLLM serve CLI subcommand to launch an OpenAI-compatible API server for LLM completions
run_headless_engines: run vLLM in headless mode to launch data parallel engine processes without an API server
run_multi_api_server: run multiple API server processes backed by vLLM core engines with ZMQ communication
create_serve_arg_parser: create an argparse subparser for the vLLM serve CLI with model, frontend, and parallel config options
launch_core_engines: launch vLLM core engine processes with a specified executor class and ZMQ addresses
